task: Brewtime: macOS menu bar app that toggles caffeinate and shows stats

features.description: BrewtimeCore has a CaffeinateController that starts `/usr/bin/caffeinate -d -i -m -s -w <app pid>` (optionally with `-t <seconds>`) and stops it; `isActive` reflects whether the process is running. Process launching is behind a small protocol so tests use a fake.
features.verify: swift test: starting sets isActive true and passes the expected arguments (with and without a duration); stopping terminates the process and sets isActive false; start while active and stop while inactive are no-ops.

evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (swift test: 8 tests green, 7 in CaffeinateControllerTests covering args with/without -t, stop terminates, start-while-active and stop-while-inactive no-ops, failed launch, restart)

features.description: BrewtimeCore has a StatsStore that records completed sessions and exposes: total sessions started, total time kept awake, longest session, sessions today, and the current session start date. It persists to an injectable UserDefaults suite and can be reset.
features.verify: swift test: recording sessions of 60s and 120s gives count 2, total 180s, longest 120s; a new store on the same defaults suite reads the same values; reset zeroes everything; sessions today counts only sessions started since local midnight (clock injected).

evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (swift test: 16 tests green, 8 in StatsStoreTests: 60s+120s -> count 2, total 180, longest 120; reload from same suite; reset zeroes and persists; sessions today across UTC midnight and in an injected Europe/Athens calendar; start/end no-ops)

features.description: An @Observable @MainActor AppModel in BrewtimeCore wires CaffeinateController and StatsStore: toggle() starts or stops caffeinate; starting increments the sessions-started count immediately; stopping records the elapsed session duration in stats. Exposes the selected duration (Indefinitely, 15 min, 30 min, 1 h, 2 h, 4 h).
features.verify: swift test with fake process launcher and injected clock: toggle on -> active and sessions count +1; advance clock 90s, toggle off -> inactive, total awake +90s; selecting 1 h passes -t 3600 on next start.

evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (swift test: 21 tests green, 5 in AppModelTests with fake launcher + injected clock: toggle on -> active, sessionsStarted 1, args without -t; +90s toggle off -> inactive, process terminated, total 90; selecting .hour1 -> next start passes -t 3600; durations map to nil/900/1800/3600/7200/14400; failed launch leaves model inactive with 0 sessions)

features.description: Menu bar UI: MenuBarExtra (.window style) whose icon is `cup.and.saucer` when off and `cup.and.heat.waves.fill` when on. The panel shows an On/Off toggle, a duration picker, a live current-session timer while active (and remaining time when a duration is set), and a stats section (sessions started, sessions today, total time awake, longest session), plus Reset Stats and Quit buttons. App has no Dock icon.
features.verify: swift build succeeds; bash scripts/bundle.sh produces build/Brewtime.app; launching it shows the menu bar icon; while toggled on, `pgrep -x caffeinate` shows a process whose args include -w <Brewtime pid>; toggling off removes it. Record what was observed in evidence.

features.description: Duration formatting helper used by the UI: formats seconds as `0s`, `45s`, `5m 03s`, `2h 05m`, `1d 3h` for stats and timers.
features.verify: swift test covering 0, 59, 60, 303, 3599, 3600, 7500, 97200 seconds and negative input clamped to 0s.

features.description: scripts/bundle.sh builds release and assembles build/Brewtime.app with an Info.plist (CFBundleIdentifier app.brewtime.Brewtime, LSUIElement true, LSMinimumSystemVersion 14.0), ad-hoc codesigns it, and works from a path containing spaces.
features.verify: bash scripts/bundle.sh exits 0; plutil -lint build/Brewtime.app/Contents/Info.plist passes; LSUIElement is true; codesign -v build/Brewtime.app passes.

features.description: When caffeinate exits on its own (duration elapsed, or killed externally), the model flips to inactive and records the session exactly once.
features.verify: swift test: fake process fires its termination handler -> isActive false, one session recorded with the elapsed time; a subsequent stop() records nothing extra.

features.description: Quitting the app while active stops caffeinate and records the in-progress session before exit (applicationWillTerminate / willTerminate notification), so stats are not lost and no caffeinate is orphaned.
features.verify: swift test on the model's shutdown() path records the session and terminates the process; manual: bundled app toggled on then quit leaves no caffeinate with its pid.

features.description: Corrupt or missing persisted stats (wrong types in UserDefaults) load as zeroes instead of crashing; sessions shorter than 1 second still count as started but add 0 to total.
features.verify: swift test writes garbage values to the defaults suite and loads a store with zeroed stats; a 0.4s session increments count and leaves longest/total unchanged at whole-second precision.

features.description: Whole suite stays green and the release bundle builds.
features.verify: swift test green; bash scripts/bundle.sh exits 0.
